rules.title: Jersey City ban on algorithmic rent coordination services
rules.requirement: Landlords are prohibited from using algorithmic rent coordination services. The ordinance is enforced both publicly and privately.
rules.coverage_text: Landlords using algorithmic rent coordination services; the summary does not state unit-count or building-age limits.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits a landlord’s use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.ambiguity_note: Secondary law-firm summary table; the ordinance's definitions, coverage and exemptions are not stated.
